messages:
incidentbot: ALERT: sev2 — delivery errors to PagerRelay for service=payments. pages failing with 5xx. trying retries, escalating suppressed.

maria: acked, digging in. any customer impact seen yet? @anna-cs can you watch DM? :eyes:

kevin: grabbing relay logs now. seeing a spike of 502s from webhook-relay gateway starting +00:01. snippet:```[2024-05-05T14:20:18Z] POST /v1/pages 502 "upstream prematurely closed connection" x-request-id=abc123```

jordan: @maria i'm on-call, coming in. are incidentbot escalations hitting secondaries?

maria: looks like incidentbot marked as delivered because PagerRelay returned 200 for the accept endpoint, but downstream webhook-relay is returning 502 on actual push to provider. automation suppressed escalation because of accept ack -> gap.

kevin: yep. ack-mismatch. PagerRelay accept endpoint is just enqueueing; it returns 200 before delivery. relay started failing when nginx keepalive pool exhausted.

maria: we need manual fallback to SMS for critical alerts. kevin, can you run the fallback job? i'll open a manual page for customers impacted.

kevin: running manual reroute -> using internal tool. command:```./tools/reroute --target=sms --filter=service:payments --count=50 --reason="pager-relay 5xx"```

kevin: result: 4 manual pages sent immediately (those were highest priority), relay still throwing 502s for bulk.

jordan: contacting ops-scheduler to wake backup oncall. @anna-cs please confirm if any customers replied or reported alerts.

anna-cs: CS checking monitoring dashboard. initial glance: ~30 customers had delayed pages (~1-2m delay). no escalations from customers yet, a few messages to support but no outage tickets opened. posting summary to CS channel.

maria: good. mitigation: disabled accept-ack suppression for PagerRelay (temporary) and flipped force-escalate=true for critical routes. also rolling nginx connection pool restart on gateway.

deploy-bot: deploy started: webhook-relay/nginx-restart v2024.5.4 -> restart on 3 nodes (canary first).

kevin: canary node restart cleared keepalive exhaustion, 502s dropped to zero on canary. rolling restart across remaining nodes.

maria: manual cleanup done. incidentbot re-enabled normal flow after verifying delivery receipts from relay via new health endpoint.

jordan: customer impact summary for incident channel: delayed paging visible to ~30 customers, median delay 90s, max ~2m30s, no missed escalations after manual intervention, root cause suspected: nginx keepalive exhaustion + accept-ack logic mismatch.

maria: filing short incident ticket INC-2026-456 and assigning to eng-infra to revert accept-ack behavior and add delivery-receipt check to incidentbot. also add synthetic end-to-end page check for PagerRelay (every 60s).

kevin: quick notes for postmortem: 1) don't treat accept-ack as delivery for suppression logic 2) healthcheck for push-to-provider, not just enqueue 3) limit keepalive connections per upstream 4) alert on 5xx rate from webhook-relay > 1% sustained.

jordan: thanks team. next: post-incident retro tomorrow 10:30 PT. action owners assigned in INC-2026-456. :white_check_mark:

maria: closing thread here, will paste final incident summary into #postmortems after retro. :memo:
